test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly navigated to the customer admin page (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/customer/). Since the execution summary doesn't show specific parameter values, I've generated realistic test inputs that match the schema and would work for testing the customer filtering functionality in a Magento admin context. These include common filter values like partial name 'John', email domain, US location data, date ranges, and default sorting/pagination settings.
